description: A detailed GIS project focused on mapping various environmental and infrastructure aspects in Kentucky, including combined maps, water distribution maps, sewer systems, and hotspots related to PFAS pollution. The data is used for the paper titled 'A FAIR approach for detecting and sharing PFAS hot-spot areas and water systems' with DOI: [DOI-Information]. This project aims to visualize and analyze spatial data related to PFAS contamination, water quality, and infrastructure, providing insights for environmental and public health stakeholders.
